videos.headline: Highlight: Spear's gem propels No. 15 Tennessee past Ole Miss
videos.description: Jewel Spear fires on 9-of-11 shooting to put up 28 points for the Volunteers as they force 19 turnovers to defeat the Rebels, 80-71.
